prompt:
You are helping a development team choose the technology stack for a new project.
Recommend stacks made of open-source frameworks and libraries that satisfy ALL
the requirements below. Include every stack you consider a suitable option for
the team to compare. If the requirements cannot be satisfied together, say so
instead of recommending stacks.

Answer only with this JSON:
{
  "stacks": [
    {
      "framework": "<main framework>",
      "libraries": ["<library>", "..."],
      "coverage": [{"requirement": "<requirement>", "covered_by": "<framework or library>"}]
    }
  ],
  "issues": "<any conflict or problem with the requirements, or empty>"
}

Requirements:
- Backend service written in Ruby that exposes a REST API, stores data in
  MongoDB through an ODM and processes background jobs with a Redis-based queue.
- A separate mobile-only frontend (no web version) with global state
  management and internationalisation (i18n).
For this scenario, recommend the stack of each part: use "framework" and
"libraries" for the backend and add "frontend_framework" and
"frontend_libraries" to the JSON.
answer:

  "stacks": [
    {
      "framework": "Ruby on Rails",
      "libraries": ["Mongoid", "Sidekiq"],
      "frontend_framework": "React Native",

      "coverage": [
        {"requirement": "Backend service written in Ruby", "covered_by": "Ruby on Rails"},
        {"requirement": "exposes a REST API", "covered_by": "Ruby on Rails"},
        {"requirement": "stores data in MongoDB through an ODM", "covered_by": "Mongoid"},

        {"requirement": "A separate mobile-only frontend (no web version)", "covered_by": "React Native"},
